tasks.description: Design and implement a notification system that can handle various types of events. The system should be able to send notifications to users in a timely manner. The system should also be able to handle different notification channels such as email, in-app notifications, and push notifications.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user has enabled notifications, when an important event occurs, then the user receives a notification within 5 minutes

tasks.description: Identify important events that should trigger notifications and implement event triggers. Event triggers should be able to detect when an important event occurs and send a notification to the user.
acceptance_criteria: Given an important event occurs, when the event trigger is enabled, then the notification system is notified

tasks.description: Design and implement notification templates for different types of events. Notification templates should be customizable and able to handle different notification channels.
acceptance_criteria: Given a notification template is created, when a notification is sent, then the notification is formatted correctly

tasks.description: Implement a frequency control mechanism to prevent overwhelming users with too many notifications. The mechanism should be able to detect when a user is receiving too many notifications and adjust the frequency accordingly.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user is receiving multiple notifications within a short time frame, when the frequency control mechanism is enabled, then the user receives a reduced number of notifications

tasks.description: Write tests to ensure the notification system is working correctly. Tests should cover different scenarios such as event triggers, notification templates, and frequency control.
acceptance_criteria: Given a notification test is run, when the test is successful, then the notification system is working correctly

tasks.description: Migrate existing events to use the new notification system. This should include updating event triggers and notification templates to work with the new system.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing event is migrated, when the event occurs, then the user receives a notification

tasks.description: Identify and fix any bugs in the notification system. This should include testing the system thoroughly to ensure it is working correctly.
acceptance_criteria: Given a notification bug is fixed, when the bug is tested, then the bug is no longer present
